The twelve Units of Grade 6 (G+M) across the school
year. Each Unit covers roughly three teaching weeks.

| Unit | Title | Skills focus | Exam type |
|------|-------|--------------|-----------|
| 1 | [A New Year at School](units/unit01_a-new-year-at-school.qmd) | speaking, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 2 | [On Holiday](units/unit02_on-holiday.qmd) | listening, speaking, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 3 | [In the City](units/unit03_in-the-city.qmd) | reading, speaking, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 4 | [Food Around the World](units/unit04_food-around-the-world.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 5 | [Daily Routines](units/unit05_daily-routines.qmd) | speaking, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 6 | [Friends and Feelings](units/unit06_friends-and-feelings.qmd) | speaking, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 7 | [An Adventure Story](units/unit07_an-adventure-story.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 8 | [School Around the World](units/unit08_school-around-the-world.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 9 | [Body and Health](units/unit09_body-and-health.qmd) | listening, speaking, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 10 | [Travelling by Train](units/unit10_travelling-by-train.qmd) | listening, reading, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 11 | [Captain Cody's Map](units/unit11_captain-codys-map.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
| 12 | [Year-End Festival](units/unit12_year-end-festival.qmd) | speaking, writing, intercultural | class test ("Klassenarbeit") |
